verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-facing bulk-operation capability, such as selecting many tickets, knowledge items or configurations and acting on them at once. Replaying historical tickets in simulations, analyzing 500–1,000 tickets during onboarding, and scheduled automations are adjacent features (testing, setup analysis, recurring tasks), not bulk operations on many items, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
